scientific.integrity: The main identity and feasibility criterion are exact algebraic consequences of the published reproduction number. A standalone script replays all reported numerical values and the disease-free eigenvalue. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the equations and parameter values printed in the public article. It does not infer what unreported scaling or code inputs may have been used, and it does not classify endemic equilibria or global dynamics above threshold.

title: An irreducible breakthrough floor invalidates a reported vaccination threshold
